take: Per the Oilers' announcement, Edmonton acquired center Filip Hallander from Pittsburgh in exchange for defenseman Spencer Stastney. Hallander has 3 points in 5 games this season and owns a 64.99 five-on-five share of expected goals, with Pittsburgh's share 14.35 points better when he plays. Stastney, who played 66 games for Edmonton last year, has just two games with the Penguins and no points. Edmonton arrives at 5-1-1 with a 52 percent five-on-five share, so Hallander joins a team already controlling chances.
